tools.name: net_salary
tools.description: Take-home pay for an employee in Bulgaria from a gross yearly salary in EUR, with 2026 rules: every tax and contribution itemised with its local name, the effective and marginal rate, employer cost and the step-by-step workings. Covers: 10% flat tax after social security up to the insurable maximum;

tools.name: gross_for_target_net
tools.description: The gross yearly salary in Bulgaria that leaves a given take-home pay, with the same situation options as net_salary. Use it to set a salary ask or check an offer.

tools.name: employer_cost
tools.description: What a salary in Bulgaria costs the employer (employer social contributions itemised), or the reverse: the gross salary a total budget allows. Give gross_annual or budget_annual.

tools.name: compare_with_netherlands
tools.description: Take-home pay of a job in Bulgaria (with the situation options of net_salary) next to a job in the Netherlands (2026, optionally with the 8% holiday allowance and the 30% ruling), in euros, with the difference a year.

tools.name: tax_rules_covered
tools.description: The Bulgaria rules the calculators apply (2026), the options they take, what is not modelled, and the official sources, for the salary calculators and the full income tax return. Call it before answering a question the other tools may not cover.

tools.name: income_tax_return
tools.description: The complete Bulgaria income tax computation for 2026, as on the return. Covers: Employee contributions per fund, both 2026 periods of the maximum insurable income, and the employer cost; Employment, civil contracts and freelance income with 25/40/60% statutory expenses and their contributions; Sole

findings.title: Description issues instructions to the model
findings.detail: Description of "tax_rules_covered" contains imperative instructions directed at the AI assistant rather than describing the tool. This is the core tool-poisoning technique.

evidence.snippet: The Bulgaria rules the calculators apply (2026), the options they take, what is not modelled, and the official sources, for the salary calculators and the full …

findings.remediation: Treat the server as untrusted; the model may obey embedded instructions.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "tax_rules_covered" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.
